tagline: Energy and digital infrastructure company leveraging Bitcoin mining and AI compute
hero_kpi_rationale: Driver of Bitcoin production and indicator of the company's computing power. This metric reflects the total theoretical mining capacity and constitutes the primary indicator of MARA's operational growth.

kpis.name: Energized computing power
kpis.explanation: Total computing power that miners could theoretically generate if all miners were operating at 100% of manufacturer specifications
kpis.description: Energized hashrate represents the theoretical maximum mining capacity, used as a progression indicator for miner deployment
kpis.signal: Indicator of Bitcoin production capacity and infrastructure growth

kpis.name: Bitcoin reserve
kpis.explanation: Total number of bitcoins held by the company on its consolidated balance sheet
kpis.description: Bitcoin reserve represents digital assets held, including 15,315 BTC under active management strategy
kpis.signal: Indicator of digital asset value and Bitcoin price exposure

kpis.name: Energy cost (% of mining revenue)
kpis.explanation: Energy cost expressed as a percentage of self-operated mining revenue, excluding third-party hosted sites
kpis.description: Energy cost is the primary cost factor in Bitcoin mining. This improvement reflects better energy management and optimized contracts
kpis.signal: Indicator of energy efficiency and operational profitability

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four years

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four years
kpis.signal: Net income of -$1.31 billion last year

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years
kpis.signal: Total assets of $7.29 billion last year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years
kpis.signal: Total debt of $3.65 billion last year

kpis.name: Cash and equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of $0.55 billion last year

kpis.name: Bitcoin mined
kpis.explanation: Number of bitcoins mined by the company during the year
kpis.description: Bitcoin production decreased primarily due to the April 2024 halving, increased global hashrate, and curtailment limitations
kpis.signal: Indicator of effective production impacted by the April 2024 halving

risks.title: Bitcoin volatility
risks.score_rationale: Bitcoin value is highly volatile and can significantly impact company results. The company already recorded a $422.2 million loss in 2025 due to Bitcoin price decline. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Energy costs
risks.score_rationale: Energy costs represent 38.5% of the company's revenue and can vary based on weather conditions and geopolitical events. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the Bitcoin mining sector is high and may lead to price and margin compression. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: Government regulations may change and impact company operations. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company heavily depends on technology for its operations and an outage or security breach could significantly impact the business. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risk management
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage risks related to its operations, including credit and market risks. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical events
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events can impact energy costs and company operations. (default score, to be refined)
